segments.text: I had eaten meat my entire life I had hunted my entire life I was killing things from when I was 5 years old I got my first gun and I'd go out in the field and just shoot everything and I had become a vegan and there was one moment in particular where I went elk hunting and I shot an elk and I walked up on it after I shot it and it was still breathing and I saw this Majestic creature breathing and I just fell apart that I had been responsible for taking its life in that moment when I broke so I became vegan because I do believe I do

hope that as intelligence progresses in this part of the universe that compassion will be a part of it you know if you eat meat that's fine do you for me it really hit home and so I guess I just feel bad about taking life it is complicated when you start talking about life I just want to note that I am trying to incorporate compassion into my life as best I can
